m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Why hello young Wizard! It's been quite a while since I saw you, hasn't it? I have such a hard time remembering these days...
What's that? You've come for a token of some sort? Hmmm... I suppose I can give you a piece of my bark. I think it will have to do. You can put it to use as a pendant or something similar.
I hope that suits your purpose, little Wizard.
<ITALICS>Bartleby concentrates for a moment, then hands you a small piece of polished bark with a hole near the top. It's surprisingly warm, almost as if it's still alive. </ITALICS>
Good afternoon, $PLAYER_FIRSTNAME$. It's pleasant to see you back here in Krokotopia, and I'm certainly pleased you thought to head out to my oasis and say hello. I trust everything is going well?
You'd like a token of some sort? Tell you what... you can have this small chain I made of twisted vine. It should do well enough.
You can consider that a symbol of my respect.
<ITALICS>Niles rummages around in his leaves, and produces a wooden chain made of twisted vine. It's strong as steel. </ITALICS>
Greetings, $PLAYER_FIRSTNAME$. Once more you honor me with your presence. What can I do for you, esteemed Wizard from afar?
You desire a token? Why, it is the least I can do. You've demonstrated your allegiance to me, and I will do what I can to assist you. Let me make a gift to you of a small clasp of heartwood.
Once that clasp is closed, only the greatest of the tree-lords can cause it to open.
<ITALICS>Oakheart opens his huge hand and gives you a small open ring of reddish wood. </ITALICS>
They each gave you an item, correct? A pendant, a chain, and a clasp? Each of living wood? Serendipity! Those items will serve perfectly! Let me see them...
Now we're just getting started...
<ITALICS>Professor Wu strings the pendant onto the chain, and closes it with the clasp. She places the necklace around your neck. </ITALICS>
Have you gotten the tokens of favor from Bartleby, Niles, and Oakheart? You won't be able to learn your new spell without those items.

How wonderful to see you, $PLAYER_FIRSTNAME$. I've heard such magnificent things about your accomplishments around the Spiral. Despite all of the adventure and excitement, it is of the utmost importance to remember your studies.
And that, my young Wizard, includes the learning of new spells. Such great power does not come without cost, and I fear that you will be challenged mightily in the trials to learn this spell.

Your first task is the easiest: you must venture forth throughout the Spiral and speak with three powerful tree-lords. You should ask each for a small token of favor, and return to me when you've collected them all.
The tree-lords you should visit are Bartleby the World Tree in Wizard City, Niles the Balance Tree in Krokotopia, and Oakheart in MooShu. Each should be happy to give you a token of their respect.
